brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to obtain an assessment (efficacy, safety, and patient reported outcomes) of basal bolus insulin delivery with PaQ in insulin-using patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).
brief_title: A Study to Assess Insulin Delivery With PaQ® in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A Prospective, Single Center Study to Assess the Performance, Safety, and Patient Reported Outcomes of Insulin Delivery With PaQ® in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Glycosylated hemoglobin A1C (HbA1c) (obtained from venous blood)
